SELECT fished_date_season AS season, cls,
       CAST(fished_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bucket,
       SUM(yt) AS yt_sum, SUM(anglers) AS ang_sum,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa,
       COUNT(*) AS n_trips
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('three_quarter','overnight','day_1_5')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING SUM(anglers) > 50
ORDER BY season, doy_bucket, cls

SELECT fished_date_doy AS doy,
       SUM(yt) AS yt_sum, SUM(anglers) AS ang_sum,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa,
       COUNT(DISTINCT boat) AS n_boats
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'day_1_5' AND fished_date_season = 2 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 185 AND 274
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT fished_date_doy AS doy,
       SUM(yt) AS yt_sum, SUM(anglers) AS ang_sum,
       SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa,
       COUNT(DISTINCT boat) AS n_boats
FROM trips
WHERE cls = 'day_1_5' AND fished_date_season = 1 AND fished_date_doy BETWEEN 255 AND 305
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
